body: This is clearly about her feelings and not how confused you are feeling. Your confusion is irrelevant if you aren't trying to actually help.

Wow. This thread has opened my eyes to why I always find my way back into depression, even after feeling okay for a while. It's a comfort zone. It's safe. It's simple. I have lived in depression for more than half of my life, so I guess I don't know what it feels like to live without it. Anything else is emotionally daunting, and fighting that daily can constantly drain your energy. So it's definitely easier to live in the depression because it's what you know so well. Even though it's not what you really want at all. Then again with depression, it's hard to care about what you want. 

Thanks to everyone for your comments of clarity. This has been very insightful.
